title: Processed Obsidian
description: adds new building blocks made from obsidian, similar to the deepslate set, including polished, brick, and tile variants.
body:
### Processed Obsidian adds brand new building blocks crafted from obsidian


# Features
## Building Blocks

Processed Obsidian adds a lot of building blocks, resembling the deepslate set. That means that it adds a polished, bricks and tiles variant

## Armore Set

It also adds a new and more powerful armor set

# Requirements

Minecraft 1.21.1
NeoForge
